title: What Algae Power Ponds Is
definition: Algae Power Ponds: ponds where algae make fuel and electricity.
description:
Algae Power Ponds: ponds where algae make fuel and electricity. This is Future Energy Systems at its most ambitious — raceway ponds research, pond logistics engineering and strain selection operations converging on a single goal: making pond hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Energy Systems will decide harvest systems outcomes this century. Algae Power Ponds is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working pond hulls, the larger raceway ponds vision stalls, and with it, the pond logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Algae Power Ponds in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Algae Power Ponds
title: Real Research Today: Algae Power Ponds
definition: Today's documented research behind Algae Power Ponds.
description:
The road to Algae Power Ponds is already being paved. The International Energy Agency tracks 500+ GW of annual solar additions in its net-zero scenarios. Space-based solar power studies (Caltech SSPP, ESA SOLARIS) test beaming power from orbit.

ITER in France is the world's largest fusion experiment, targeting first plasma and Q>10 operation. Together these programs form the raceway ponds foundation that Algae Power Ponds will build on — the pond logistics results, the strain selection methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as pond logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Algae Power Ponds
definition: Estimates Algae Power Ponds readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Algae Power Ponds components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a pond hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Algae Power Ponds Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Algae Power Ponds operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Algae Power Ponds installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 55110 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where raceway ponds monitoring, pond logistics redundancy, or strain selection maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Algae Power Ponds Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Algae Power Ponds: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Algae Power Ponds — ponds where algae make fuel and electricity.

Phase 1 — Prove (raceway ponds): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (pond logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (strain selection): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (harvest systems): pond hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and sunbelt-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
